raw.chosen: Timeout must win over generic early exit for a resumable exit-75 child
raw.reasoning: The public readyTimeoutMs contract requires MountReadyTimeoutError plus stop cleanup once retry budget expires; ordinary non-resumable exits still retain their specific launch failure.

retrospective.summary: Fixed exit-75 deadline handling and eliminated the shutdown-test unhandled-rejection window; focused tests passed 20 repeated runs plus the full launcher test and SDK typecheck.
